TypeHint.head: Helmets, hats, circlets, crowns, headbands.
TypeHint.armor: Light, medium, heavy and natural armor (dnd5e armor type).
TypeHint.focus: Spellcasting foci, rods, wands, staffs with the Focus property.
TypeHint.any: Any wondrous item, trinket, ring or piece of clothing.

Doll.Title: Equipped
Doll.AutoFillHint: Put already equipped items into matching slots and attach containers

Ground.Zone: Drop here to place on the ground
Ground.Title: Place on the ground
Ground.HowMany: How many {item} do you want to drop?

Warn.WrongSlot: {item} does not fit into the slot {slot}. (GM: hold Shift to assign anyway.)
Warn.NotContainer: {item} does not fit into a container slot. (GM: hold Shift to allow it anyway.)
Warn.NotWeapon: {item} cannot be held in this hand (weapons, tools, instruments, foci and shields).
Warn.ContainerNotEmpty: Empty the container before dropping it on the ground.
Warn.NoToken: Your character needs a token on the current scene.
Warn.NoGM: A GM must be online to drop items on the ground.
Warn.NotReachable: {item} is packed away and cannot be used in combat.
Warn.NoAttunement: No free attunement slot ({max}) – {item} is equipped without attunement.
Warn.NotInventory: {item} is not an item from the inventory.

Info.AutoFilled: Equipped items have been sorted in.
Info.Repaired: Repaired containers that were inside each other: {items} – they are now unstowed.

Editor.Title: Paperdoll Layout (all characters)
Editor.Label: Label on the sheet
Editor.NoSelection: Click a slot to edit it, or a + to add a new one.
Editor.Hint: Click anywhere on the figure to add a slot there (or use a +). Drag slots to move them. Any type may be used several times. Wondrous items are recognized by name; if that fails, hold Shift while dropping it on the slot. Hands and armor class can be moved too.
Editor.IconReset: Default icon of the slot type

Editor.Name: Paperdoll layout
Editor.Label: Edit slots
Editor.Hint: Add, remove and type the equipment slots of the paperdoll for all characters.

Enabled.Name: Replace inventory tab
Enabled.Hint: Show the paperdoll inventory on character sheets.

HideSidebar.Name: Hide sidebar on the inventory tab
HideSidebar.Hint: The portrait moves into the paperdoll; other tabs keep the sidebar.

PlayersEquip.Name: Players may equip
PlayersEquip.Hint: If disabled, only the GM can change the paperdoll.

Strict.Name: Strict slot types
Strict.Hint: Only allow items that match the slot type.

HideWorn.Name: Hide equipped items from the list
HideWorn.Hint: Equipped items, weapon sets and attached containers only appear on the paperdoll, not in the item list.

Ground.Name: Allow dropping on the ground
Ground.Hint: Needs Ascandir - DnD5e Lootplacement or Item Piles.

AutoEquip.Name: Auto-place equipped items
AutoEquip.Hint: Equipping an item in the list (shield icon) moves it onto the matching paperdoll slot or into the active weapon set.

Purse.Name: Use purses
Purse.Hint: Coins are kept in purse containers with a limited capacity. The normal currency of the sheet is hidden. Turning it off brings the normal currency back.

PurseCap.Name: Purse capacity (coins)
PurseCap.Hint: How many coins a purse holds by default. The GM can change it per purse on the sheet.

Attune.Name: Attune on equip
Attune.Hint: Equipping an item that requires attunement attunes it if a slot is free; removing it from the paperdoll ends the attunement. Switching weapon sets does not change attunement.

Highlight.Name: Highlight empty slots
Highlight.Hint: Keeps the icons of empty slots readable on bright or colourful portraits.

Colors.Name: Paperdoll icon colours
Colors.Label: Choose colours
Colors.Hint: Each player picks the icon colour of empty paperdoll slots per character.

NewUnequipped.Name: New items arrive unequipped
NewUnequipped.Hint: Items added by importers (e.g. Plutonium), shops or other characters are placed in the inventory and are not equipped.

Debug.Name: Debug log
Debug.Hint: Writes every automatic action of the paperdoll (equip, unequip, sort in) to the browser console (F12).

GM.Name: Settings for the Game Master
GM.Label: Open GM settings
GM.Hint: Everything that applies to all characters: inventory tab, equipping, attunement, ground, purse. Only the GM sees this.

Player.Name: Settings for players
Player.Label: Open player settings
Player.Hint: Personal settings: icon colours of empty paperdoll slots per character, debug log. Every player can change these for themselves.

AutoContainers.Name: Magic wand attaches containers
AutoContainers.Hint: If enabled, the magic wand button also fills free container slots (backpack, quiver, pouch …). Off: containers are only attached by dragging them onto a container slot.

BgPlayers.Name: Players choose their own background
BgPlayers.Hint: If enabled, every player can set their own paperdoll background per character in the player settings. Otherwise the GM's background applies to everyone.

BgGlobal.Name: Paperdoll background (GM)
BgGlobal.Hint: Background image behind every portrait. Used for everyone – or, if players may choose their own, for everyone who has not picked one.

Settings.GMOnlyWarn: Only the Game Master can change these settings.

Purse.Title: Purse
Purse.None: No purse – this character cannot carry coins.
Purse.Loose: No room in the purse, loose coins
Purse.Overflow: The purse of {name} is full – {n} coins are lying in the inventory as a coin pile (Unstowed). Give it to someone else or make room.
Purse.MigrateIn: Purses are now active. Move every character's coins into a purse? Characters without a purse get one.
Purse.MigrateOut: Purses are now off. Move all coins from purses back into the characters' normal currency?
Purse.ConvertAsk: Some coin types were turned off. Convert those coins in all purses into the remaining types (e.g. 10 electrum → 5 gold)?
Purse.PileDesc: Coins that did not fit into the purse. Click to put them into the purse, or give the pile to someone else.
Purse.StillFull: The purse is still full – {n} coins remain in the coin pile.

Colors.Title: Paperdoll icon colours
Colors.Hint: Pick the colour of the empty-slot icons for each of your characters, so they stand out against the portrait. Only you see your choice.
Colors.NoActors: You do not own any characters.

Classic.Switch: Switch to the classic dnd5e inventory (for testing, only for you)

Weapons.Title: Weapons
Weapons.Empty: No weapons in the weapon sets yet. Drag a weapon onto the main or off hand of the paperdoll.
Weapons.Always: Always equipped – everyone can attack unarmed

Background.Title: Paperdoll background
Background.Hint: Background image behind the portrait of each of your characters (useful for portraits without background). Empty = the GM's background.
Background.GMOnly: The GM sets the background for everyone.
Background.NoBrowse: You are not allowed to browse files. Paste an image path or URL into the field instead.
